question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Impulsive
solution:
The correct option is** 'Option 3**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word** Impulsive** means something done without careful thought; likely to act suddenly and without thinking​​.(आवेगशील)

 
 
• ​**Example**- She made an impulsive decision to quit her job.
 
 
 
• ​"**Cautious**" means someone careful to avoid potential problems or dangers; careful; wary.(सावधान)
 
 
• **​Example**-Any cautious tourist will guard her passport.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of '**Impulsive**' is '**Cautious**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is** Cautious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Here are some other options explained along with their Hindi meaning and example sentences.

 
• **Passive**(निष्क्रिय): accepting or allowing what happens or what others do.

 
 
• ​**Example**- Life is too short for any of us, and all of us, to be passive.
 
 
 
• **Aggressive(**आक्रामक) : ready or likely to attack or confront.
 
 
• ​**Example**- This was not an aggressive protest as we are not an aggressive or violent group.
 
 
 
• **Hasty(**जल्दबाज़ी) :done with excessive speed or urgency.
 
 
• ​**Example**- It was a hasty decision you may live to regret.​​​​
